data_quality.note: Corrections replace their superseded event. Reopen evidence removes the superseded verified outcome from later regenerations.

change_failure_rate.exclusion: failed agent attempts and CI failures without production impact
change_failure_rate.inclusion: production failures attributed to a deployment
change_failure_rate.missing_data: unavailable unless deployment and incident failure coverage both span the window
change_failure_rate.source_query: live rollout and authoritative incident validation

cohort_cost_per_accepted_change.end_event: verified_outcome or other terminal task event
cohort_cost_per_accepted_change.exclusion: reserved ceilings from known spend and events outside the intake cohort
cohort_cost_per_accepted_change.inclusion: successful and failed attempts, review/correction work, cancelled and abandoned tasks
cohort_cost_per_accepted_change.missing_data: known subtotal is separate; complete value is unavailable if any expected cost is unknown
cohort_cost_per_accepted_change.numerator: cost of all expected cost events for every task in the intake cohort

deployment_frequency.exclusion: PR merges, retries of the same deployment identity, and issue closure
deployment_frequency.inclusion: each managed application and production environment separately
deployment_frequency.missing_data: unavailable unless deployment coverage spans the full window
deployment_frequency.numerator: distinct production deployments in the half-open window
deployment_frequency.source_query: live Argo, workload, digest, and chart receipt validation

factory_intake_to_verified_outcome.denominator: accepted changes in the intake cohort
factory_intake_to_verified_outcome.exclusion: PR merge, deployment alone, retries as changes, and summed attempt duration
factory_intake_to_verified_outcome.inclusion: tasks first received >= start and < end with active verified outcome evidence before end
factory_intake_to_verified_outcome.missing_data: right-censored tasks remain incomplete; zero accepted changes yields unavailable

factory_rework_rate.inclusion: failed review and correction work linked to the task
factory_rework_rate.missing_data: unavailable with zero accepted changes or incomplete factory history
factory_rework_rate.numerator: accepted cohort tasks with at least one review_correction

failed_deployment_recovery_time.denominator: failed deployments with linked recovery evidence
failed_deployment_recovery_time.exclusion: issue closure and agent retry duration
failed_deployment_recovery_time.inclusion: one elapsed interval per failed deployment
failed_deployment_recovery_time.missing_data: open failures are right-censored; incomplete incident coverage is unavailable
failed_deployment_recovery_time.source_query: live rollout and authoritative incident validation

interventions_per_accepted_change.exclusion: intervention_required signals without a completed human action
interventions_per_accepted_change.inclusion: completed operator-authored actions linked to cohort tasks
interventions_per_accepted_change.missing_data: unavailable with zero accepted changes or incomplete audit coverage
interventions_per_accepted_change.numerator: explicit operator_intervention events with an actor

production_lead_time.denominator: production deployments with a linked merged change
production_lead_time.exclusion: issue closure, PR merge without rollout, and verified outcome without deployment identity
production_lead_time.inclusion: each managed application and production environment separately
production_lead_time.missing_data: unavailable unless deployment coverage spans the full window
production_lead_time.source_query: live Argo, workload, digest, and chart receipt validation

production_rework_rate.exclusion: factory review corrections with no production failure
production_rework_rate.inclusion: successful corrective deployments whose corrects_deployment_id identifies the failed production deployment
production_rework_rate.missing_data: unavailable unless deployment and incident coverage both span the window
production_rework_rate.numerator: deployed changes requiring a later corrective deployment
production_rework_rate.source_query: live rollout and authoritative incident validation

repository_merge_count.exclusion: closed-unmerged pull requests, replayed records, and merges outside the window
repository_merge_count.inclusion: pull requests whose merged_at is >= start and < end
repository_merge_count.missing_data: unavailable unless GitHub pagination covers the full window
repository_merge_count.numerator: distinct active pr_merged changes in the half-open window

repository_open_to_merge.denominator: merged pull requests with both timestamps
repository_open_to_merge.exclusion: parallel attempt durations and changes missing either event
repository_open_to_merge.inclusion: one elapsed interval per distinct merged pull request
repository_open_to_merge.missing_data: reports known/total coverage and is unavailable with zero known intervals

repository_delivery.warning: Repository merge is not production deployment or verified outcome.

scope.accepted_change: a cohort task with active verified_outcome evidence before window end
scope.factory_cohort: tasks whose first task_intake is in the window
scope.production: each listed managed application and environment is evaluated separately

slo_proposal.breach_response: manually inspect evidence links and coverage, identify the measured bottleneck, and propose a reviewed corrective change; no automatic enforcement

cost.prerequisite: complete cohort cost including failed, correction, and abandoned work

slo_proposal.evaluation_window: rolling 28 completed UTC days, after one fully covered window exists
slo_proposal.minimum_evidence: non-zero denominators and complete factory, cost, deployment, incident, and operator-audit coverage for the evaluation window
slo_proposal.reason_targets_unset: The repository-only baseline does not support numerical production, autonomy, or complete-cost targets.

reliability.prerequisite: complete deployment failure and recovery evidence

source_coverage.query: paginated merged and closed-unmerged GraphQL commands in factory/baseline.md, filtered to factory/ heads
private audit, decision, and control records
live Argo, workload, image digest, and chart receipt validation
Polylane or another authoritative incident source
